Resolves #19670

Adds `Neo.list.ValuePicker`: fixed-height buffered checkbox rows with typed option keys, safe text labels and contextual counts. Selection is a host-written projection; pointer, Space and Enter emit toggle intent. Literal search and the unselected-match cap share one options-Store predicate, retain every selected option and expose an honest refine footer above the cap.

Logical keyboard movement crosses the pool by record identity. The worker owns its keys and scroll effect; only the latest rendered request may focus a slot. Navigator's key/scroll defaults are preserved; a recycled active record now emits its captured identity even when the physical element is unchanged.

Change class: capability (feat).
Evidence: L2 real Neo/Store unit contracts and L3 browser input achieved; L3 required for this list leaf. The floating header surface, filter writes and 100k latency journey remain owned by #19671 under #19643.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC1 | CI-covered `list/ValuePicker.spec.mjs`: 10,001 options, bounded plain-vdom pool, fixed-height default, no per-option component. |
| AC2 | CI-covered unit: external checks are silent, pointer intent leaves selection unchanged until echoed; browser confirms projection and no Enter-generated pointer click. |
| AC3 | CI-covered unit: literal case-insensitive substring, selected nonmatches retained, clear restores admission, no selection event. Browser exercises literal `(` input. |
| AC4 | CI-covered unit: exact N unselected matches plus every selected key, count-aware refine footer above cap only; footer included in scroll extent. |
| AC5 | CI-covered unit: selected zero-count and changed-label options remain removable, arrivals are unchecked; 500 count edits perform zero admission scans, 500 label edits coalesce to one scan, and queued source replacement/destruction stays fenced. |
| AC6 | CI-covered units and component browser: actual Arrow/Home/End input crosses recycled slots; Space/Enter target logical identity; rapid repeats, stale navigation, invalid newer requests and Tab/wheel lifetime controls. |
| AC7 | Owning unit spec covers all list contracts; component spec exercises the real main/worker seam. Shared unit/component CI and repository commit guards. |
| AC8 | Diff contains list/SCSS, Navigator and their tests; no grid, collection or data changes. Only the host-owned options Store receives this list's predicate, released on replacement/destruction. |

## Deltas from ticket

Accepted [Ada's intake refinements](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19670#issuecomment-6136768198): one selected-union admission predicate and a non-record refine footer; direct literal text-node highlighting; no self-selecting model. [Root's intake](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19670#issuecomment-6136900794) adds a narrow existing Navigator seam because mounted-DOM Home/End/Enter handling cannot provide logical buffered input.

Navigator subscription data adds opt-in `workerKeys` and `scrollIntoView`; navigation events carry captured `activeRecordId`. The picker uses them to prevent duplicate key/scroll effects and stale slot attribution. Ordinary key/scroll behavior and default same-slot record-change firing have an executed browser control. Coverage uses the existing empty-viewport app; no new fixture app or component-per-value layer. The canonical generator adds the tracked hierarchy edge.

The [original author applied the revised ledger](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19670#issuecomment-6137565581), preserving ACs and scope. Count-only edits use Buffered's mounted-row writer; other edits coalesce per task. The picker now follows the [W3C multi-select listbox pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/listbox/): `listbox`/`option`, one `aria-selected` state, and a presentational refine message exposed by `aria-describedby`.

Decision Record: Not needed. Decision Record impact: none. Structural fast path: content-specialized list beside `Chip`/`Color`, specs beside Buffered. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; shared baseline jobs carry its portable PR-body/substrate checks. The repo-wide reactive-tag inventory reports existing omissions; this class's reactive configs are documented and JSDoc parses.

## Test Evidence

All coverage runs in CI. Before handoff, the browser witness also rejected the intermediate implementation: all 14 keys arrived, but intermediate native scroll effects moved the pool back before final focus. The final implementation sends one scroll effect after its render receipt, suppresses Navigator scrolling for this subscriber and rejects stale captured slot identity. The strict focused-record oracle remains unchanged.
